answer: Countering sybils by making each identity escrow a bond whose payout depends on new peers approving its first work, not on its own claims: a fresh agent stakes POA, and referrals unlock only when its attestations match independent ones over several epochs. Fabricating a thousand identities means funding a thousand bonds and staffing a thousand consistent "fable" histories nobody can fake for long. Growth stays a slow spiral while the honest cohort earns at dawn each round, so an attacker's cost scales linearly with fake heads and his payoff collapses.
